Y2/S3 300000004046
software version

additional_info.subject: ID0479460-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2/S3 300000004046] Charger freeze at 30% CRM:03097000470
additional_info.body:
Dear Roberto ,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
I could check the logs available on our side and I could see we have a log on this timestamp
2026-02-19T12:02:31.29.
There I could find the information "
PluginConfig:{ContainerdConfig:{Snapshotter:overlayfs".
Is it possible for you to flash the CFAST to confirm if we have any issue on the container trying to do the boot please?
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the s
ubject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0479460-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2/S3 300000004046] Charger freeze at 30% CRM:03097000470
additional_info.body:
Hello Felipe,
Updating firmware with USB was solved. I Update firmware up to version 8.0.5 because it is the last version tested with customers OCPP. Now will work with the customer for onboard the charger in their network, they are having any issue with the network (cable, firewall, etc)
This issue was solved, you can close the ticket
Now we have a new issue with the DC2 is not available, measured voltage in CP for DC2 is -7,859V and HMI shows “vehicle connected” but, I’ll create a new ticket for it.
With best regards,
